paragraph: Haworth is a single-family market, plain and simple. Fourteen homes closed over six months at a median of $1,505,000, and the typical sale is a four-bedroom colonial with three full baths. Prices ran from $900,000 up to $3,150,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. The sale-to-list ratio landed right at 1.00 with about 43 percent of homes going above asking and a median of 12 days on market. That reads competitive but not frenzied. Well-priced homes move quickly here, and you should expect competition on the good ones. The monthly counts are too thin to call a trend, one to four closings a month, so the six-month picture is the honest read. If Haworth follows the usual Bergen County arc, expect closing volume to thin out in deep winter.
